questions.prompt: Rosie swam a lot when she was very young because
questions.explanation: Her brother Joel was a very good swimmer, so she practised frequently to become as fast as him. Matching her brother motivated her.
questions.evidence: Joel was better at swimming than anyone we knew, and I practised as often as possible so I could swim as fast as him.

cueReview.method: Publisher transcript matched to local word timestamps
cueReview.startQuote: before I even started school, my dad used to take my brother Joel and me to the pool in town.
cueReview.endQuote: I practised as often as possible so I could swim as fast as him.
cueReview.matchedText: Yes, before I even started school, my dad used to take my brother Joel and me to the pool in town. He just wanted us to do something in our free time that wasn't looking at a screen. Jean was better at swimming than anyone we knew, and I practiced as often as possible, so I could swim as fast as him.
cueReview.notes: Included the explicit brother relationship before the motivation. ASR calls Joel 'Jean' in the following sentence; the earlier relationship and surrounding content anchor the cue.
